question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Capable
solution:
The correct answer is **"Suitable." **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Capable" **means having the ability or skill to do something. (कुछ करने की क्षमता या कौशल होना)
 
• **"Suitable" **means appropriate or fitting for a particular purpose or situation. (किसी विशेष उद्देश्य या स्थिति के लिए उपयुक्त या उपयुक्त)
 
• Synonyms of "capable" include **"competent," "able," and "skilled." **-
 
 
• **Example **:* She is capable of handling the project on her own.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Willing"**: Ready and happy to do something, without reluctance. (बिना किसी हिचकिचाहट के कुछ करने के लिए तैयार और खुश)
 
• **"Reliable": **Trustworthy and dependable, someone or something you can count on. (भरोसेमंद और भरोसेमंद, कोई व्यक्ति या ऐसी चीज़ जिस पर आप भरोसा कर सकते हैं)
 
• **"Seasoned": **Experienced and skilled, often as a result of many years of practice or exposure. (अनुभवी और कुशल, अक्सर कई वर्षों के अभ्यास या अनुभव के परिणामस्वरूप)
